ledger_laws.manifest_reference: every node, issue and external reference in the ledger resolves against the consumed emacs_train.v1 manifest; a reference that resolves nowhere fails closed
ledger_laws.decomposition_wiring: a decompose entry lists exactly the split children: the successor set equals the hard dependency children of the subject minus the declared retained prerequisites, so a revision can never silently drop or invent a node
ledger_laws.fan_in_reachability: every split child reaches its parent fan-in: the child's manifest successor set contains the decomposed subject, so decomposition preserves the fan-in denominator path
ledger_laws.cell_exclusivity: every acceptance cell maps to exactly one declared owner or an explicit retirement; cross-owner drift such as one client family satisfying another family's cell is rejected
ledger_laws.work_drain: every unique work item is preserved to a declared node or external authority or explicitly retired with a reason; supersession and transfer never let unique reviewed work disappear
ledger_laws.insert_wiring: an insert entry declares its wiring edges and the manifest carries each edge with exactly the declared class; insertion without wiring is rejected
ledger_laws.incorporate_boundary: an incorporate entry adds no node, declares the separate-train boundary and resolves its external authority; a separate train stays separate
ledger_laws.retarget_state_match: a retarget entry's declared after-state matches the manifest bytes exactly, including the canonical candidate-adoption rule where one exists
ledger_laws.metadata_neutrality: a metadata_only or nonsemantic_prose entry carries zero invalidations; harmless movement never churns specs, contexts or packets
ledger_laws.material_invalidation: every material semantic class carries at least one typed invalidation with a basis, a reason and a ruling evidence trail
ledger_laws.append_only: the ledger is append-only: sequences are contiguous from one, entry identifiers match their sequence, and no entry is ever edited or removed
ledger_laws.movement_coverage: the initial ledger records exactly the ten frozen material movements of the governing issue; removing, duplicating or reordering one fails closed
ledger_laws.sync_explicitness: every material entry names its required synchronization controllers exactly with a typed action; no free-form related-work instruction is accepted
ledger_laws.no_automatic_mutation: every entry forbids automatic execution; the ledger performs and triggers no GitHub mutation, live observation or host proof
ledger_laws.canonical_determinism: the ledger digest is a pure function of order-canonical content; serialization is invariant under input order and two checker runs print byte-identical output
